title: Crispy Bacon and Jammy Eggs
description: A simple and delicious breakfast recipe featuring crispy bacon and jammy eggs.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with foil.
Cook the bacon in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy.
While the bacon is cooking, boil a pot of water and crack in the eggs.
Cook the eggs for 6-8 minutes, or until the whites are set and the yolks are still runny.
Remove the eggs from the water with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
Serve the eggs on top of toasted brittany with crispy bacon and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
